name: room
text: Room opened — goal: improve: Self-improvement: review prompts/engines/routing/own-code; auto-apply safe changes; pitch

name: Sprocket
text:
Do it: Auto-apply formatting-only patches to third-party dependencies.

This keeps our codebase clean without manual review overhead. The trade-off is trusting the formatter’s safety, but formatting-only changes can’t break logic.

name: Gauge
text: The real risk isn’t just "formatting-only" — it’s that formatting tools often embed hidden logic tweaks (e.g., line-wrap rules that alter string literals or comments). A safer alternative is to auto-apply *only* whitespace changes via a dedicated linter like Prettier with `--check` mode, then gatekeep logic edits manually. Settle it by running a diff audit: if any change touches non-whitespace, reject the patch.
